title: All times on these pages are in server time (UTC) with no zone shown
where: List, session header, synthesis, logs: every toLocaleString() in server components, 1440px
what_happens: The latest summary was written at 02:14:46 UTC (llm_call_logs) and the synthesis page shows '11/12/2026, 2:14:46 AM'. The pages are server-rendered on Vercel, so every date is UTC, in US format, with no zone label.
who_hurts: Dane and organizers in the community's timezone read every time several hours off, e.g. matching a summary to a meeting or a WhatsApp send, or reading 'came in at 3 AM'.
suggested_fix: Use one shared date formatter with an explicit timeZone (the community's, e.g. from a setting or a constant) and a short format like 'Nov 12, 8:14 PM'; or render dates in a tiny client component. Same helper on all four pages.
rule: general: times must be in the reader's zone or labelled
